# Operation page native review handoff, 2026-10-04

IAR-01 found that the default operation loader reconstructed the public operation without its native `planReview` or `approvalRound`. The real page consequently disabled approval for a retained plan and treated a later plan gate as proposal round zero. This candidate preserves the actual stored round and the review returned by the native operation reader. It removes the stale assertion that no readable plan is persisted.

The loader validates the native review with `operationPlanReview`, bounds and scrubs it separately from the operation metadata, then revalidates the sanitized shape. An absent or unreadable review remains absent; a digest supplies no substitute. Separately bounding the review prevents its size from truncating the operation's expiry or current round. Existing tenant/member checks and the native reader's refusal of missing, foreign, stripped or inaccessible source rows continue through the existing sanitized page error boundary. The selected public fields exclude raw source and plan values.

The added controls in `tests/platform-ui/reads-and-loaders.test.ts` use the actual loader and actual operation page/actions/card via Node server rendering. They use the native PGlite operation/evidence/source tables, real broker approval and execution transitions, an explicit scripted policy and synthetic source metadata. The positive round-one case retains a consumed round-zero approval by the same human and requires the real page to enable that human's eligible current decision. A partial current-round decision stays awaiting approval but disables a duplicate decision. Other controls preserve the viewer-role guard, the digest-only missing-evidence approval refusal with rejection available, and missing/foreign/fully stripped/inaccessible source refusal. Stored canaries challenge raw plan/source exclusion, diagnostic scrubbing and ordinary operation-field redaction.

This is an authored source candidate awaiting the root's independent review. No tests, compiler, lint, source acquisition, OpenTofu process, installation, services, Docker, databases, APIs, cloud calls or commits were executed by the author. The controls are test source, not passing evidence. Node server rendering and PGlite/model fixtures do not establish browser identity or Origin enforcement, live permission, actual PostgreSQL privileges/concurrency, source acquisition provenance, retained archive readback, or real provider effects.

Owned paths are only `src/app/(product)/platform/_lib/loaders.ts`, `tests/platform-ui/reads-and-loaders.test.ts` and this new handoff. `pages.test.tsx` remains untouched because the default-loader-to-page controls fit in the existing Node loader suite. The exact 45 prepared dependency paths remain read-only. The frozen incremental packet is under `logs/operation-page-review-20261004/revision1` outside the checkout.

Root verification still requires its compiler and targeted Node/component suites, followed by the authorized real-browser default operation journey and the separate actual PostgreSQL, historical Temporal replay, original-byte OpenTofu and provider/package gates. IAR-02's current source-binding check at the final raw-plan dispatch boundary remains a separate authority owner task. Any required CI case/manifest integration belongs to its gate owner; this candidate does not edit that manifest, widen constructors or bypass default composition.
